game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass, a narrow pumice pass: the fire warden must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by molten golems.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pumice Pass: a narrow pumice pass
core_gameplay_loop: In Pumice Pass, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the fire warden's power beats the shield shown by molten golems. Each round, a new sulfur crystals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the power value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 130 points of sulfur crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Pumice Pass'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Pumice Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 50 seconds.
